name: @w6w-apps/zoho-projects
description: Manage Zoho Projects portals, projects, tasks, task lists, milestones, issues and time logs.

w6w.longDescription:
Zoho Projects puts project management into a workflow: list portals, users and projects, create, update, trash and restore projects, manage task lists, tasks, milestones and issues (bugs), and read, log and edit time.

It uses the current V3 API (`/api/v3`). Zoho hosts every account in one of eleven regional data centres, each with its own sign-in endpoint and API host, so this app routes each region through its own dedicated connection rather than one that could send a request to the wrong region.

Filters, bulk operations, comments, attachments, dependencies, custom fields, forums, documents, users administration, templates and automation are deliberately left out.
